name: क्रेज़ी कलर्स
tagline: रंग या चिह्न मिलाएँ और सबसे पहले अपने पत्ते ख़त्म करें।
description: ब्राउज़र में क्रेज़ी कलर्स मुफ़्त खेलें: रंग और चिह्न मिलाएँ, वाइल्ड खेलें और सबसे पहले पत्ते ख़त्म करें। बॉट्स, एक डिवाइस या ऑनलाइन।
about: Crazy Colors is kefche's own take on a family of card games played all over the world, the one Crazy Eights belongs to. Everyone starts with seven cards, and the goal is simple: be the first to get rid of all of them. On your turn you play a card that matches the top card of the pile, by colour or by symbol.

The deck is ours: four colours, each with its own shape, so the cards read just as well for colour-blind players. Each colour has numbers from 1 to 9 and three action cards. Skip passes over the next player, Turn reverses the order of play, and +2 makes the next player draw two cards and miss their turn. Wild cards go on anything and let you name the next colour.

When you can't play, or would rather not, draw a card: if it fits you may play it at once, or keep it. Play with 2 to 8 players, against bots on three levels, with friends passing one device, or online, where hands are dealt on our server so no one can see yours. Choose 7 cards for a full game or 5 for a quick one.
howToPlay: Choose 7 or 5 cards a hand, then Play vs bots or Play on this device. One card is turned up to start the pile.
On your turn, play a card of the same colour or the same symbol as the top card. A Wild goes on anything: then choose the next colour.
Skip passes over the next player. Turn reverses the order of play (with two players, you go again). +2 makes the next player draw two cards and miss their turn.
If you can't or don't want to play, tap the pile to draw a card. If it fits, you may play it; otherwise keep it, and your turn ends.
The first player to play their last card wins.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a card to lift it and tap it again to play, or drag it up. Tap the face-down pile to draw.
Mouse: click a card to play it.
Keyboard: move through your hand with the arrow keys and press Enter to play. Tab reaches the pile and the buttons.
On one device, the screen covers your hand between turns: pass the device, and the next player taps to see theirs.
tips: Keep your Wilds for when nothing else fits: they always do.
When you name a colour, choose the one you hold most of.
Save Skip and +2 for a player who is close to going out.
Watch how many cards the others hold: a player with one card left is about to win.

faq.question: Is Crazy Colors free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Is this Crazy Eights?
faq.answer: It belongs to the same family: match the colour or the symbol, and Wild cards change the colour. The deck, the names and the cards are kefche's own.

faq.question: Can I draw a card even if I could play?
faq.answer: Yes. Drawing is always allowed. If the card you draw fits, you may play it straight away, or keep it.

faq.question: What happens when the draw pile runs out?
faq.answer: The played cards, except the top one, are shuffled to make a new draw pile.

faq.question: Can other players see my cards online?
faq.answer: No. Online, the cards are dealt on our server, which sends each player only their own hand and how many cards the others hold.
